messages:
lee-sales: Quick check on FoxPoint POC closure 1 - they need Order Form + MSA/DPA cleared before issuing PO. Any absolute blockers?

olivia-legal: Main items: liability cap 1 they'd proposed 3x fees. We should offer: "greater of $250,000 or fees paid in prior 12 months". DPA: they want residency + subprocessor consent 1 we accept Appendix A (updatable by us) with 30d notice. If they insist on 3x, escalate to VP Legal (48h).

drew-ps: Pricing: I updated quote (link shared). Show Net30 and Net45. Note Dedicated commit reduces unit price but requires ~60d provisioning notice.

anya-cs: Security asks: SOC2 Type II under NDA 1 we can provide. SAML SSO for POC 1 estimate ~10 business days after IdP metadata.

lee-sales: For signature routing they want procurement + finance. Proposed DocuSign order: procurement -> legal -> lee-sales -> redwood-finance. Also include PO_NUMBER field.

ops-bot: DocuSign checklist: signing_order set, PO_NUMBER field present. PO_NUMBER_REQUIRED = true if customer confirms PO.

olivia-legal: Draft liability clause ready. I'll attach redline PDF in NDA share and note escalation path.

lee-sales: I'll send redlines + both billing options and create envelope once they confirm signers. Ping if any other blockers. :thumbsup:

anya-cs: I'll DM their security lead for SOC2 NDA and schedule SAML kickoff.

drew-ps: Heads-up to procurement: Dedicated commit needs lead time. Flag it when you send quote.

olivia-legal: All noted from Legal. :white_check_mark:
